faqLead: Straight answers to the questions builders, owner-builders and certifiers ask us about aluminium patio beams.

faq.q: What size aluminium patio beams does Alyspan come in?
faq.a: Alyspan is available in both 100mm x 50mm and 150mm x 50mm beam sizes at lengths to suit your application. The 100 x 50 beam is supplied in 6.0m lengths and the 150 x 50 in 8.0m lengths, and both cut down on site.

faq.q: What aluminium alloy are Alyspan beams made from?
faq.a: Both Alyspan sections are extruded from 6063 – T6 aluminium. The 100 x 50 has an area of 599 mm² and weighs 1.635 kg/m; the 150 x 50 has an area of 759 mm² and weighs 2.072 kg/m.

faq.q: Do Alyspan beams comply with Australian Standards?
faq.a: All structural sections comply with the Australian standards for structural design, aluminium structures and wind loads for housing: AS 1170.0, AS 1170.1, AS 1170.2, AS 4055-2006 and AS 1664-1997. The span tables are certified by Ross Engineers, Practicing Structural Engineers.

faq.q: How far can an Alyspan aluminium beam span?
faq.a: It depends on load width, wind classification and how the beam is set out. For a single span with no overhang next to a building up to 4.8 m high, a 150 x 50 beam spans up to 5,100 mm in N1 and N2 at a 1,500 mm load width; as an equal continuous span it reaches 6,900 mm in N1. Every certified table is on this page.

faq.q: Which Alyspan span table should I use?
faq.a: Use Case 1 when the building the patio attaches to is up to 4.8 m high, and Case 2 when it is up to 12.0 m. Then pick single span (one beam between two posts) or equal continuous span (one beam over three or more posts), and whether the beam overhangs the end post by up to 600 mm. W is the width of roof the beam carries.

faq.q: Can Alyspan span tables be used for a freestanding patio?
faq.a: No. The certified tables are for attached patio, awning and carport designs only, with the roof deemed attached to an existing approved dwelling, a roof pitch up to 5° and posts up to 3.0 m high. Ask us for anything outside that.

faq.q: Can I cut Alyspan beams on site?
faq.a: Yes. Manufactured from aluminium Alyspan is easy to cut on site and light weight making it ideal for the "DIY" Home Owner or Handyman building an outdoor patio or living area.

faq.q: What colours are Alyspan beams and brackets available in?
faq.a: Beams and posts are stocked in Mill and Pearl White, and brackets in Gal and Pearl White, with Monument also available. Other colours are available; check the lead time and colours at time of order.
No. Aluminium does not rust, and Alyspan beams are powder coated in a Hi-Gloss finish, so there is no repainting cycle.

faq.q: How long does Alyspan take to arrive?
faq.a: Alyspan beams, posts and connectors are bought in, so allow about 2 weeks, plus about a week for freight. Insulspan roof panels are made to order: allow about 4 weeks, plus about a week for freight.

Everything else, including other lengths and colours, can be ordered through any Bunnings as a special order, or direct from us.

faq.q: How do I order Alyspan aluminium beams and posts?
faq.a: Call 1300 132 787 or email sales@quickbuiltsystems.com.au with your patio, awning or carport dimensions and we will come back with beam sizes, post centres, the full parts list and a price, supplied from Silverdale NSW.

faq.q: What is the wall thickness of the 90 x 90 aluminium post?
faq.a: 2.0 mm (plus or minus 0.25 mm), in 6063-T5 aluminium, weighing 1.823 kg/m, from the extrusion's die drawing.

faq.q: How many posts will my patio need?
faq.a: It depends on the spans. Pick the beam from the span tables on this page for your load width and wind class, and that sets how far apart the posts can be.
